name: Stashit
title: stashit.app
shortDescription: Stashit helps users sort, organize, and securely back up emails and files in one unified platform. It integrates seamlessly with Gmail for email management and supports various file types for easy access and retrieval. Ideal for professionals and students who need to declutter their digital space and enhance productivity. Example use case: A student uses Stashit to manage research articles and course emails efficiently.
pros: Integrates with Gmail for easy email management
Supports automatic backup and organization of files
Offers a fuzzy search for quick content retrieval
cons: Currently limited to Gmail, with IMAP pending
